title: 5.01 / Online Directories
slide_intent: Adapt identity to another site’s structure so customers can find the store without confusing the host and tenant brands.
strategic_value: Correct logo files and readable descriptions can preserve Spectrum’s identity within a mall directory.
demonstration: A directory-list screenshot is paired with a store detail page, annotated for monochrome artwork, logo selection and host typography.
practical_value: Choose the logo variant for the host surface and retain the mall’s typography unless a Spectrum font is requested.

content_islands.name: Heading and context
content_islands.spec: Place the title left and the two-page directory explanation above the screenshots.

content_islands.name: Directory listing
content_islands.spec: Place the tenant-list screenshot at left with a cyan leader to the note requiring supplied black artwork for monochrome production.

content_islands.name: Store detail
content_islands.spec: Place the Spectrum detail screenshot at right with separate cyan leaders for logo and typography decisions.

ingredient.name: Directory identity
ingredient.role: Make the store identifiable inside a host website.
ingredient.application: Prefer the primary logos; use dark blue on light and reverse on dark. If production is monochrome use the black file. Let the mall set typography, or supply Open Sans if requested.
ingredient.scope: Online mall directories in the 2017 guide.
